info.title: Bastion Browser API (RFC-005 candidate)
info.description: Browser-only SSH/RDP/VNC through guacd; one connection, one stream, one recording. Availability is declared honestly by /info. Production readiness is false until independent engine and real-browser acceptance.

get.description: Excludes soft-deleted users. Disabled but undeleted users remain visible and continue reserving their normalized usernames. User response fields are unchanged; there is no deleted flag, recycle bin or restore route.

200.description: Live user page excluding soft-deleted identities

post.description: Username is trimmed and ASCII-lowercased. A soft-deleted username may be reused, but creation always assigns a new UUID and the newly supplied password, with no inherited old Grants, login sessions or historical ownership. Disabled but undeleted users still reserve their usernames.

username.description: Normalized name is 1-64 ASCII characters, begins with an alphanumeric character and otherwise permits alphanumerics, underscore, dot and hyphen.

get.description: Missing or soft-deleted users return 404; disabled but undeleted users are still readable.

patch.summary: Update live user role or availability (admin-only)
patch.description: At least one of role/enabled is required. Role changes or disabling revoke old logins. Soft-deleted users cannot be updated or re-enabled.

delete.description: No request body. Requires browser session Cookie, exact configured Origin, matching X-Bastion-CSRF/cookie and quoted positive If-Match for the current live revision. Soft deletion hides the identity from the user list and makes user detail return 404; it denies further login, old access tokens, refresh, unconsumed tickets and runtime connections. Audit events, historical connections, recordings, approved host keys and old Grants remain associated with the old UUID. The username becomes available for a new independent account with a new UUID and password, without inherited Grants, sessions or historical ownership. There is no restoration, recycle bin, bulk deletion or CLI delete. Never automatically retry DELETE; RESULT_UNKNOWN requires reading server state, and REVISION_CONFLICT requires rereading the live revision. After 204, a failed list refresh is only a read failure: keep it visible and never repeat DELETE.

204.description: Soft deletion confirmed with no response body; audit/history are retained

post.description: Cookie/Origin/CSRF only. Issue a 30-second single-use ticket bound to exact asset/account/login/revisions. Manual reconnection creates a fresh ticket; failures never restore or replay one.

201.description: One-time secret returned only here; Cache-Control:no-store

get.description: Exact Origin and same login Cookie; Sec-WebSocket-Protocol exactly [bastion.guac.v1,ws_token], echo only bastion.guac.v1. No query, Authorization, token storage or logging. Binary UTF-8 chunks <=32768 bytes, incremental fatal decoder and Unicode-scalar lengths. Instructions <=8388608 bytes; permit direction-owned text/plain clipboard <=262144 decoded UTF-8 bytes (VNC input Latin-1 only), exclude clipboard transfer from recording; forbid audio/video/files/pipe creation, not owned display/clipboard blob/ack/end. No channel multiplexing or control JSON. SSH negotiates bastion.ssh.v1; RDP/VNC negotiate bastion.guac.v1. Wrong protocol cannot consume a valid ticket. See docs/ssh-xterm.md for binary terminal frames.

get.description: Authenticated verified streaming NDJSON v2, no-store, no Range, no total 5-minute read timeout. meta(seq=0,elapsed_us=0,format_version=2,connection_id,target_protocol,width,height,dpi); output(seq,elapsed_us,data_base64) containing <=32768 bytes Guacamole display UTF-8; end(seq,elapsed_us,reason). Strict contiguous sequence, monotonic time, one end and clean EOF. Invalid/truncated UTF-8, partial/unknown format and checksum faults are visible errors, never complete. Offline Guacamole display, read-only, flush backpressure, pause/play/restart without full-file buffering or seeking.

post.summary: Discover an RDP leaf certificate SHA-256 and security mode for explicit administrator confirmation
post.description: Bodyless admin-only request with cookie, exact Origin, CSRF and positive If-Match, like SSH discovery. Resolves the saved asset through deny-first network policy, connects only the approved numeric address, negotiates X.224 for TLS or CredSSP and completes a TLS handshake whose server signature is verified, then closes without CredSSP or any RDP data: no target credentials are ever sent and nothing is stored. Limited to four concurrent discoveries and ten per administrator per minute, shared with SSH. Returns the leaf SHA-256, the protocol the server selected and the matching security mode (nla when the server selects CredSSP, tls otherwise), with the scanned revision. Confirm both with asset PATCH using this revision; changed revisions require rereading and rescanning. Every RDP session still verifies the approved pin on its own socket before authentication.

200.description: Discovered certificate fingerprint and security mode; nothing is stored

post.summary: Discover SSH host keys for explicit administrator confirmation
post.description: Bodyless admin-only request with cookie, exact Origin, CSRF and positive If-Match. Resolves the saved asset through deny-first network policy and scans only the approved numeric address, without target credentials or automatic trust updates. Limited to four concurrent scans and ten per administrator per minute. Returns SHA-256 fingerprints and the scanned asset revision. Confirm the chosen key using existing asset PATCH with this revision. Changed revisions require rereading and rescanning. The eventual SSH session still verifies the approved key on its own socket before authentication. Requires ssh-keyscan on the server.

200.description: Discovered keys; no approved key is changed

get.description: Flat groups, including empty groups. Operators learn group metadata only through their exact-authorized /assets rows. No group-level authorization.

patch.description: Requires positive quoted If-Match, exact Origin, Cookie and CSRF. Names must be unique. Does not change asset routing, credentials or grants.

delete.description: No body. Requires positive quoted If-Match, exact Origin, Cookie and CSRF. Atomically moves member assets to ungrouped and increments their configuration revisions; routing revisions, accounts, credentials, grants, pending tickets and live connections remain valid. Assets are never deleted. Group deletion is audited. A confirmed write followed by refresh failure must not replay the write.

204.description: Group removed, member assets retained as ungrouped; no response body

BrowserSession.name: bastion_session
BrowserSession.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Secure browser access session. Must never be placed in localStorage or substituted as bearer token.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact configured browser Origin; required on mutations and WebSocket upgrade.

Csrf.name: X-Bastion-CSRF
Csrf.description: Matches bastion_csrf cookie; required on mutations.

PositiveIfMatch.name: If-Match
PositiveIfMatch.description: Quoted positive current live revision (signed 64-bit integer). Missing header returns 428, invalid format returns 400, and a wrong live revision returns 412; no automatic retry.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor; stable ordering; do not synthesize.

group_id.description: Single asset group; null means ungrouped. Organizational metadata only, never an authorization grant.

Asset.description: Enabled administrators have implicit access; operators need exact grants; auditors cannot connect. SSH/RDP username is required; VNC username is null. Domain is RDP-only.

stream_protocol.description: Server-selected target stream: SSH uses xterm terminal frames; RDP/VNC use Guacamole.

Grant.description: Exact asset/account binary access. Ordinary operators require an enabled, unexpired matching Grant; enabled admins have implicit access even after Grant deletion; auditors have none.

ErrorCode.description: Serialization uses SESSION_TICKET_* and SESSION_EXPIRED; legacy TICKET_* and ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED are accepted by the Rust deserializer. Error messages are display-only, never routing decisions.

ssh_host_key.description: Optional SSH host public key. Omit/null to await administrator fingerprint confirmation. Manual import remains supported; fingerprints and known_hosts are not key input. No session is issued until a key is approved.

rdp_certificate_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of leaf certificate DER. Omit/null to await administrator confirmation of a scan; manual import remains supported. No session is issued until a pin is approved, and sessions validate it on the same socket before target authentication.

group_id.description: Single asset group; null means ungrouped. Organizational metadata only, never an authorization grant.

ssh_host_key.description: Optional SSH host public key. Omit/null to await administrator fingerprint confirmation. Manual import remains supported; fingerprints and known_hosts are not key input. No session is issued until a key is approved.

AssetPatch.description: protocol is immutable and rejected on PATCH. Trust and security fields are protocol-specific. Update requires If-Match.

ssh_host_key.description: Null for SSH means awaiting administrator confirmation; existing approved keys are preserved.

group_id.description: Single asset group; null means ungrouped. Organizational metadata only, never an authorization grant.

CredentialInput.description: none only VNC; password all protocols; private_key only SSH, currently OpenSSH-format Ed25519, unencrypted or AES-256-CTR with a valid passphrase. RSA failed the pinned engine's real authentication gate and is rejected; PKCS PEM, ECDSA and other ciphers are rejected. VNC classic password maximum eight UTF-8 bytes. Responses never include secret input.

AccountCreate.description: label required. SSH/RDP require nonempty username; VNC requires null username. domain only RDP (null otherwise). credential none only VNC, private_key only SSH.

AccountPatch.description: domain:null explicitly clears an RDP domain; obey immutable asset protocol constraints.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the leaf certificate DER, the value to pin as rdp_certificate_sha256

selected_protocol.description: Security protocol the server selected in X.224 negotiation

security.description: Security mode to save with the pin: nla when the server selected CredSSP

name.description: Trimmed server-side, no control characters; unique among groups.
